items.title: Microsoft Teams: QR code protection in Teams messaging
items.description: Microsoft Teams will provide additional protection for QR codes shared by external users in messages. Images containing QR codes from external senders will be obscured by default and require users to reveal them before viewing or scanning. This helps reduce the risk of phishing and fraud by encouraging more deliberate interaction with QR code content.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Add multiple steps when building a workflow from scratch
items.description: You will now be able to add multiple steps to your workflow when building one from scratch.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Updated header and dashboard for chats and channels on mobile
items.description: You can now get oriented and take action faster when using Teams on mobile, with a redesigned header and lightweight dashboard that brings key channel details, people, and pinned content into one intuitive place. It creates a more predictable, familiar experience across desktop and mobile so you can move faster with less friction.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Create and customize PBI reports
items.description: We are introducing a new feature for leaders and analysts of Viva Insights, where they can view a Power BI report, and edit time range, filters, attributes and change visuals as per their organizations' needs. They can then save the report for viewing later.

items.title: OneDrive: Refreshed file browsing and filtering experience in OneDrive Web
items.description:
OneDrive is making it easier to find and work with files across Microsoft 365. We're refreshing the filtering experience across OneDrive Web, updating existing filters in views like Home, Shared, People, Meetings, and Favorites to support multiple filters at once, and bringing those same filtering capabilities to folder-based experiences such as My files and shared folders. Users can also filter content by file type using both filter pills and the filter pane.

We're also bringing the modern Sha

items.title: Microsoft Clipchamp: New text and shape animations in the video editor
items.description: Clipchamp Editor will support simple animations for text layers. Users can apply preset in/out animations, adjust how long the animation lasts, choose its direction, and preview the animated text in the editor prior to exporting. This capability will be available across web and native desktop versions of Clipchamp.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention – Device Health Reporting Dashboard
items.description: This dashboard will allow admins to view the device health across all their devices to ensure the system is healthy and ready to receive policy updates and quickly identify devices that are not ready.

items.title: Planner: Microsoft Planner tab support for shared and private channels in Microsoft Teams
items.description: Now you can add Microsoft Planner as a tab in shared and private channels in Microsoft Teams, which allows to create and manage tasks directly within the channel.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Create Videos in the Clipchamp Start Page
items.description: Users can use Copilot to create videos directly from the Clipchamp Start page. Turn a simple prompt or existing document into a polished video in minutes. Copilot will automatically draft a script, selects visuals, add narration, and assembles the video for you—no video editing experience required. Review, refine, and export your video quickly, all in one flow.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-labeling scalability, policy management, and reporting enhancements
items.description: Microsoft Purview is improving auto-labeling capabilities to help organizations manage and validate labeling policies at enterprise scale. These enhancements expand support for larger SharePoint scopes, improve policy management flexibility, and provide richer visibility into auto-labeling activity.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Tab organization enhancements
items.description: Microsoft Edge is expanding tab and Workspace organization capabilities to suggest groupings, names, visuals, and labels. Users can manage these experiences through the proposed “Let Microsoft Edge help keep your tabs organized” setting under Privacy, search, and services > Search and connected experiences; administrators can control them using the TabServicesEnabled policy.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Automatic recording and transcription choices align with admin policies
items.description: Meeting organizers will only see automatic recording and transcription choices in Meeting Options that are allowed by their organization's existing meeting policies. A new Record only choice lets organizers automatically start recording without starting transcription. Depending on the organizer's policies, available choices can include Record and transcribe, Transcribe only, Record only, and Off. When both recording and transcription are disabled by policy, the automatic setting is not shown.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Admins can control profanity filtering in meeting transcripts
items.description: Teams administrators will be able to use a meeting policy to control whether profane words are masked in live transcription and saved meeting transcripts. Filtering remains on by default. When an organizer is assigned a policy that turns filtering off, profane words can appear without masking in both the live and saved transcript, while live captions continue to follow each participant's existing profanity setting.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Automatically unsubscribe users from notifications sent by scam and malicious sites
items.description: Microsoft Edge now helps further protect users from malicious web notifications. When a notification leads users to a site that Microsoft Defender SmartScreen blocks as a scam, phishing, or malware page, Edge automatically stops that source from sending users further notifications and lets users know. Users can review and restore any of these sites anytime under edge://settings/privacy/sitePermissions/allPermissions/notifications.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection- File Labeler and File Viewer for MacOS
items.description: This feature is bringing the Information Protection Filer Labeler and Viewer applications to the MacOS platform. Enabling customers to have the same capabilities available on Mac. Core functionality will be available with the exception of the Advanced label-based protection feature.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: PDF Viewer Performance Improvement and Minor Visual Updates
items.description:
The PDF Viewer in Microsoft Edge is migrating to WebUI2, enhancing responsiveness and introducing a series of subtle visual upgrades aimed at improving overall usability and utility. This migration ensures UI coherence with the rest of the browser while maintaining the same user experience.
The update focuses on improving underlying performance, consistency in design elements, and a smoother interaction without altering any existing workflows for users.

items.description: Viva Insights is creating an Agent Dashboard, designed to be a central place for leaders, delegates and analysts to understand how your organization is adopting agents. #copilotcontrolsystem
